decisions.reason: A coolant pressure booster builds directly on the firm's core pumping and coolant management know-how, so it can read early market feedback and refine the product with its own engineering.
A coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's filtration expertise and its sustainability-driven coolant offering, giving it high absorptive capacity to improve the product.
A coolant nozzle line with several models complements the firm's coolant systems and is easy to adapt using existing design knowledge and customer insight from metalworking users.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a core conveying competence for metalworking customers, so the firm holds deep related knowledge and established service channels.
A magnetic belt chip conveyor extends the firm's established conveyor platform within its modular system approach, with well-understood performance and customer needs.
A hinged belt chip conveyor is a staple of the firm's conveying portfolio, and accumulated engineering and service experience makes it straightforward to sustain and improve.
